\[
\theta_D(y_D)=
\sum_{B\subseteq D}(-1)^{|D\setminus B|}
h(y_B,y^0_{V\setminus B}).
\]

\[
h(y)=\sum_{D\subseteq V}\theta_D(y_D).
\]

\[
h(y_u,y_v,c)-h(y_u,y_v^0,c)
-h(y_u^0,y_v,c)+h(y_u^0,y_v^0,c)=0.
\]

$\psi_C(y_C)=\exp\{\sum_{D\mapsto C}\theta_D(y_D)\}>0$，便有

\[

\[
